bio: If you’re looking for a restaurant in which to escape the stresses of daily life, Filandón guarantees a thoroughly tranquil experience on the edge of El Pardo, in the heart of the countryside but just a few minutes from the centre of the Spanish capital. In its pleasant, rustically inspired dining rooms, one of which stands on the terrace, savour traditional cuisine where the focus is always on the best-possible ingredients, ranging from superb fish sourced daily from the Pescaderías Coruñesas company to select cuts of meat and delicious rice. Many of the dishes here are cooked on the grill....
